repair_audits.confirmed_root_cause: The pinned llama-server returned HTTP 200 with valid JSON and one message, but message.content was an empty string while message.reasoning_content contained 1948 characters. The evidence answer therefore never reached citation or answer-contract validation.
repair_scope: Send chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false so the pinned Qwen chat template uses the bounded generation budget for final answer content.
Continue to reject empty final content and never promote reasoning_content into an answer.
Capture finish_reason and reasoning-presence metadata before final-content validation so failed responses remain diagnosable.
Keep one real request, no retry, no offline fallback, exact citation validation and evidence gates unchanged.

repair_audits.confirmed_root_cause: The prior model contract required and exposed application-owned path/line syntax while response validation also treated broad path-like line text as an invalid citation. The real response reached HTTP 200 with 163 final characters and then triggered that validator. The exact triggering token cannot be recovered because the legacy result intentionally did not retain the response text or offending snippet.
repair_audits.evidence_gap: The 163-character response and exact offending token were not retained by the historical attempt; this audit does not invent either value.
repair_scope: Make supplied evidence IDs such as [E1] the only model-authored citation syntax.
Keep canonical path, line range, excerpt and source identity application-owned and map validated IDs back to those values.
Do not expose path/line citation markers in model-visible evidence and explicitly forbid invented paths, line ranges, legacy markers and unsupplied IDs.
Reject unknown evidence IDs and precise path-plus-location citation attempts while allowing ordinary technical text such as line 12, type annotations and Markdown filename links.
Record bounded, redacted citation diagnostics and distinguish citation validation from answer-contract validation without changing HTTP request success counts.
Preserve an independently completed no-evidence refusal even when the evidence case fails.
